messages.subject: Shiny Authentication issue
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to have a shiny app get authentication to access Salesforce data. Javascript is being used to get the user's access token, which could then be used to access the data inside the org.
I am using rforcecom package to get the data. rforcecom's default login is not being used to authenticate, but instead I am using access token (which btw can be used to login). While all this works fine in R console, when I try to authenticate it from Shiny, it gives me this:  "Error in <Promise>: Could not resolve host: NAservices".
Is there any way we can implement this in shiny?
